incidents.name: WMRP mints on zero-value self-transfer
incidents.notes: WMRP treats BNB sent to it plus a zero-value transfer as a mint trigger, so alternating deposits and 0-amount transfers let the attacker mint over 6,000 MRP and sell it back.
